entries.name: Add a person
entries.description: Click the '+' icon at the top of your screen, then select 'Person'.

entries.name: Add a task
entries.description: Click the '+' icon and select 'Task' to add a task to your agenda.

entries.name: Import your data
entries.description: Upload a CSV of your contacts by clicking 'Import' on the 'People' tab.

entries.name: Send a tracked email
entries.description: After syncing your email, select all contacts on the 'People' tab and click 'Send campaign.'
